title: Identification and validation of biomarkers associated with cellular senescence and demethylation in acute myocardial infarction.
authors: Su, Wenhua; Huang, Hong; Ruan, Qingrong; Liu, Shiqi; Dan, Juhua; Zhao, Yan; Zhang, Hong; Huo, Qian
one_liner_zh: 该文通过机器学习筛选心肌梗死衰老相关生物标志物，仅预测了转录因子互作但未涉及TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联薄弱。
abstract: Acute myocardial infarction (AMI) triggered cardiomyocyte senescence and impaired cardiac function. Methylation modifications and related enzymes in patients were also significantly altered, but the association between cellular senescence and demethylation remained unclear. This study obtained data from public databases, screened candidate genes by intersecting differentially expressed genes (DEGs) with related genes, identified characteristic genes using three machine learning methods to determine biomarkers, and explored their regulatory mechanisms through gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) and other approaches. Finally, BCL3, MMP9, NAMPT, and TLR4 were identified as potential biomarkers. GSEA showed they were significantly enriched in 18 common pathways. Thirteen immune cells, such as CD8 T cells, differed significantly between AMI and control samples. A total of 58 miRNAs, 10 lncRNAs, and 242 transcription factors (TFs) were predicted to interact with these biomarkers. Targeted analysis predicted 25 potential therapeutic drugs for AMI, and the biomarkers could target Retinoic acid CTD 00006918. GeneMANIA analysis identified 20 functionally related genes, while Friends analysis showed BCL3 had prominent functional similarity. Reverse Transcription Quantitative Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-qPCR) results validated the expression of biomarkers, consistent with bioinformatics analyses. These findings may provide valuable clues for AMI treatment.
abstract_zh: 急性心肌梗死（AMI）触发心肌细胞衰老并损害心脏功能。患者中的甲基化修饰及相关酶也发生显著改变，但细胞衰老与去甲基化之间的关联仍不清楚。本研究从公共数据库获取数据，通过将差异表达基因（DEGs）与相关基因取交集筛选候选基因，利用三种机器学习方法鉴定特征基因以确定生物标志物，并通过基因集富集分析（GSEA）等方法探索其调控机制。最终，BCL3、MMP9、NAMPT和TLR4被确定为潜在生物标志物。GSEA显示它们在18条共同通路中显著富集。AMI样本与对照组之间，CD8 T细胞等13种免疫细胞存在显著差异。共预测到58个miRNA、10个lncRNA和242个转录因子（TFs）与这些生物标志物相互作用。靶向分析预测了25种针对AMI的潜在治疗药物，且这些生物标志物可靶向维甲酸CTD 00006918。GeneMANIA分析识别出20个功能相关基因，而Friends分析显示BCL3具有显著的功能相似性。逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）结果验证了生物标志物的表达，与生物信息学分析一致。这些发现可能为AMI治疗提供有价值的线索。
